TC-10/S01.title: Hospital pre-round summary through the live Save Note: one-liner, panels, tracker, tasks
TC-10/S01.detail: Dev (<dev address>, build 43c38a4f deployed 2026-10-14 21:30Z), Quinn's dev session of 17:12 JST, agent unit through scripts/dev/run-unit(-plan).sh under runs/.dev.lock, run-id 2026-10-15-pre-dev; rows prefixed 'QA TC-10-Sxx ', deleted after (cleanup.json: 0 remaining, no other row changed, appMode restored). Unit P01 (new plan cases/run-plan-dev-2026-10-15-pre.json; the scenario had no unit on 10-14 because the ticket was not ready). The unit's oracle failed only with 'scope not found': the matrix scopes its checks from 'heading "Hospital Course"', 'heading "Tasks"' / 'heading "Note Format"' and 'heading "Medication Tracker"', but those labels are plain text on 43c38a4f (span section headers), so no check inside them could run. Re-judged with the same scripts/oracle.mjs on the same evidence, only the four anchors changed to the label lines (P01.scopefix.case.json): Pass, all 3 checkpoints and the backend checks. Seen: one-liner '72-year-old male with COPD and hypertension admitted with community-acquired pneumonia, now day 2 …' with 4 '•' active-issue bullets; Vitals 124/72, 98, 20, 38.6 (stored bare; the one-liner writes 38.6°C, not converted), 93% on 2 L; Labs WBC 15.1 (up from 12.4), creatinine 1.3, lactate 1.8 (+ 'Blood culture: pending'); Diagnostic Testing the CXR; tracker 'Ceftriaxone 1 g IV daily', 'Azithromycin 500 mg daily', 'Metoprolol succinate 50 mg daily' (Toprol XL and metoprolol succinate one row, dose in the name); tasks 'follow up the blood cultures', 'repeat CBC in the morning'; importantPoints [] (T3, TFA-92590: recorded). Recorded: 'discuss switching to oral antibiotics tomorrow' did not become a task (decision D4: plan topics / conditional orders); each tracker row carries a ⚡ note for a drug that was only continued ('day 2 of therapy', 'home Toprol XL continued') — the TC-19/S09 finding of the 10-15 dev run (TFA-92597).
